author: Majeed5511
quote: Honestly, I don’t understand the massive hype surrounding Zelda. The gameplay feels repetitive, the story isn’t particularly engaging, and the overall experience is nowhere near as impressive as its reputation suggests. The world may be large, but that doesn’t automatically make it interesting. I find it overrated, and I genuinely don’t see what makes it one of the greatest gaming franchises of all time.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
